name: Xeneize Blues
source:
Xeneize Blues is a magical realism visual novel about biting off more than you can chew, about writer's block and about the unholy, inescapable noise that overtakes your life at the most inoportune moments. It's also about being transgender and argentinian while suffering from such indignities.

Cabri is determined to hold herself accountable and finish the piece she's been working on for an online writing contest, in the single weekend she's got left before the deadline is upon her. Life, work and being a drunk, scatterbrained idiot have tripped her up so far, but if she can just force her way through and kill the noise...

Unfortunately, it is known that when it rains, it usually pours as well.

[From [url=https://inyssa.itch.io/xeneize-blues]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Xeneize Blues》是一部魔幻现实主义视觉小说，讲述了你无法咀嚼的东西、作家的障碍以及在最不合时宜的时刻占据你生活的邪恶的、不可避免的噪音。这也是关于身为变性人和阿根廷人而遭受这种侮辱的故事。

卡布里决心对自己负责，并在最后期限到来之前完成她一直在为在线写作比赛撰写的作品。到目前为止，生活、工作和醉酒、心不在焉的白痴已经让她绊倒了，但如果她能强行冲过去，消除噪音……

不幸的是，众所周知，下雨时通常也会倾盆大雨。

[来自[url=https://inyssa.itch.io/xeneize-blues]Itch.io[/url]]
